Definition: properly, to rub to pieces or pulverize; intransitively, to disappear as dust; to salt whether internally (to season with salt) or externally (to rub with salt)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to tear away, dissipate; 1a) (Niphal) to be dispersed, be dissipated; 2) to salt, season; 2a) (Qal) to salt, season; 2b) (Pual) to be salted; 2c) (Hophal) to be rubbed or washed with salt
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
